name: CoreShop IndexBundle Filters
observations: Implemented Filter management for Studio v2 in IndexBundle
Uses EntityTabbedManager from ResourceBundle
Has FilterManager, FilterDetail, and SettingsForm components
Supports two types of conditions: pre-conditions and user-conditions
Implemented 6 condition types: range, select, multiselect, boolean, search, nested
Uses separate ConditionRegistry instances for pre-conditions and user-conditions
FilterApi extends EntityApi with additional methods: getConfig, getFieldsForIndex, getValuesForFilterField
Backend routes defined in routing.yml with coreshop.resources pattern
Widget registered as 'coreshop-index-filters' in main.ts
Icons registered in icon-library module
All components built successfully with rsbuild
Fixed menu integration: widget name must be 'coreshop-index-filter' (singular) to match backend menu definition
Menu widget ID pattern: {resource}-{function} = 'coreshop-index-filter'
Backend defines: resource='coreshop.index', function='filter'
MenuBundle auto-generates widget ID from resource + function
